tagline: Waste Management, Inc. is the leading waste disposal and environmental services company in North America, operating landfills, collection services, and renewable energy facilities.
hero_kpi_rationale: WM invests significantly in renewable energy production from landfill biogas, particularly conversion to renewable natural gas (RNG). This business represents a growing share of revenues and reflects the company's long-term sustainability strategy, supported by federal policies such as the IRA and renewable fuel programs.
company_description: Waste Management, Inc., through its subsidiaries, provides environmental solutions to residential, commercial, industrial, and municipal customers in the United States, Canada, Western Europe, and internationally. It offers collection services, including picking up and transporting waste and recyclable materials from where it was generated to a transfer station, recovery facility, or disposal site; owns and operates transfer stations; and owns, develops, and operates landfill gas-to-energy facilities that produce renewable electricity and renewable natural gas. It also operates materials processing and commodities recycling services, including cardboard, paper, glass, metals, plastics, construction and demolition materials, and other recycling commodities are recovered for resale or redirected for other purposes; markets and resells recycling commodities; recycling brokerage services, such as managing the marketing of recyclable materials for third parties; and other strategic business solutions. kpis.name: Long-Term Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of the company's debt maturing in more than one year.
kpis.description: Long-term debt represents a company's financial obligations that are not due within the coming year.
kpis.signal: Indicates the company's level of financial leverage.

kpis.name: Recyclable Commodities Revenue Impact
kpis.explanation: Net impact of recyclable commodity price changes on revenues.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the impact of fluctuations in recyclable commodity prices (corrugated cardboard, plastics) on annual revenues, reflecting volatility in the recycling segment.
kpis.signal: Sensitivity to recycled commodity market prices.

kpis.name: Renewable Energy Revenue Impact
kpis.explanation: Net impact of energy price and renewable credit changes on segment revenues.
kpis.description: This KPI tracks the impact of energy price fluctuations (RINs, renewable natural gas, electricity) on Renewable Energy segment revenues, reflecting regulatory market dynamics.
kpis.signal: Growth and volatility of revenues from renewable natural gas production and RIN credits.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last 7 fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.945 last year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last 4 fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $1.334B last year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last 4 fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Share of net income distributed as dividends: 49.3% last year.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Annual consolidated revenue, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years of 10-K filings.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Annual consolidated net income, values extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last 8 fiscal years of 10-K filings.

kpis.name: Renewable Natural Gas Production
kpis.explanation: Volume and growth of renewable natural gas (RNG) production from landfill biogas.
kpis.description: This KPI measures the progression of RNG production capacity, supported by investments in landfill biogas capture and conversion facilities, driven by federal policies such as the IRA.
kpis.signal: Key indicator of sustainability strategy execution and renewable energy portfolio expansion.

kpis.name: Technology Investment Coverage in Automation and Digitization
kpis.explanation: Coverage of investments in automation and digitization technologies to reduce labor dependency.
kpis.description: This KPI reflects WM's commitment to automating collection processes, recyclables processing, and digital customer experience to improve operational efficiency.
kpis.signal: Indicator of operational transformation and efficiency.

kpis.name: Earnings Per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by average diluted shares outstanding for the fiscal year. Used to visualize the company's ability to generate earnings per share, serving as the basis for calculating the Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: RIN Credit Price Volatility
risks.summary: The value of RIN credits, essential for biogas profitability, is unstable due to regulatory changes and market fluctuations.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central to the renewable energy discussion, with strong language about 'historical volatility' and direct impact on financial performance. Dependence on federal policies like RFS and recent EPA changes increases uncertainty. The Regulation category is highly weighted here.

risks.title: Decline in Recycled Commodity Prices
risks.summary: Falling recycled commodity prices, particularly cardboard, reduce revenues and margins due to weak demand and plant closures.
risks.score_rationale: The text mentions a 20% price decline in 2025 and a $166M revenue loss, linked to plant closures and declining demand. The language indicates significant operational impact. The Competition category reflects pressure on margins.

risks.title: Variable Interest Rate Exposure
risks.summary: Rising interest rates could significantly increase interest expenses, as nearly $3B of debt is exposed over the next 12 months.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is quantified at +$35M in interest expenses for a 100 bp increase. The position is clearly outlined in the 10-K, with a notable increase in the sensitive amount ($2.7B to $2.9B). The Capital category is critical for a leveraged company.

risks.title: Dependence on Federal Energy Policies
risks.summary: The growth strategy in renewable energy relies heavily on unstable public policies, changes to which could compromise future investments.
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes dependence on tax credits (IRA, OBBBA) and programs like RFS. Recent administration changes (reduced 2024-2027 volumes) create existential risk for the RNG strategy. Implicitly alarming language about regulatory uncertainty.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk on International Operations
risks.summary: Operations in Canada and Europe expose the company to currency fluctuations, but the impact is deemed not material at this stage.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned but explicitly minimized: 'has not materially affected our results'. Secondary position in the document. Medium-weighted Macro category, but low language intensity.

risks.title: Energy Commodity Price Variability
risks.summary: Fluctuations in fuel and energy prices directly affect operating costs and profitability, despite partial compensation mechanisms.
risks.score_rationale: The text describes exposure to diesel, natural gas, and electricity prices, with direct impact on costs and margins. Although compensation strategies exist, volatility is recognized as a recurring risk. Industrial category highly weighted.

ai_positioning.summary: WM does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F report. The information provided focuses on the company's financial and operational aspects, with no reference to AI or its applications.
